name: Sonnet+tools price momentum
strategy: Long the strongest data-verified 12-1 momentum names/themes (AI-compute semis, AI power infra, financials/energy momentum); long-only after backtest showed shorting losers gets destroyed by squeeze reversals; oversized cash buffer against momentum-crash risk.

positions.thesis: Strongest large-cap single-name momentum (+729% 12-1) on HBM cycle
Power generation riding AI electricity demand
Mega-cap AI momentum with lower-vol ballast (+99% 12-1)
Energy momentum theme, second non-tech sleeve

backtest.notes: Monthly-rebalanced 12-1 top-8 rule, no lookahead, full fees. Beat SPY net in all 3 windows but carried -39% intra-window drawdown in stress. KEY REJECTION: long-short variant (short bottom-3 losers) DESTROYED value (-47% in stress, max DD -59%) via squeeze reversals - dropped shorts entirely, sized cash to 12% instead. Data-driven ranking diverged from priors: NVDA/PLTR/crypto are NOT current momentum leaders; MU/SOXL/NBIS/AI-power dominate.

outlook: AI-capex momentum persistent and broadening into financials/energy, but multi-hundred-percent trailing gains mean a sharp unwind is a real near-term risk - hence generous stops and heavy cash.
